description: The 3D viewer window, and nothing else. It has no title bar: it moves by its top handle (or Shift-drag), stretches by its corner handles (start-resize-dragging), and closes itself from its own right-click menu, moves itself on Shift-drag and goes full screen from that menu; it listens for gesture zoom and precise control (one hand turning the model) from the camera window, and emits only to say a model is open (jarvis://model-pong / model-gone). Saving a model goes through the app's own save_model_file command, which writes only .glb files into the JARVIS folder. No opener, no shell, no filesystem.
